hints.title: Level Order Traversal
hints.text: Traverse the binary tree level by level. The sum of the nodes in the final level is the answer.

hints.title: Sum Reset at Each Level
hints.text: At the start of each level iteration in BFS, reset the level sum to zero.

hints.title: Return Final Level Total
hints.text: When the queue becomes empty, the last computed level sum corresponds to the deepest leaves.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Multiple passes to find max depth first and then collect nodes repeat tree traversal work.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Standard queue-based level order traversal processes each node once and naturally tracks final level sum.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies BFS level traversal cleanly, resetting level sum at each step.
complexity.notes: DFS tracking (max_depth, sum) is an alternative single-pass solution.
